charter: v2

# Design principles

Source: `docs/source/ELEVATION.md` §3.1. LingAfriq is a daily, voice-first practice companion. A screen serves one job: **learn it** (comprehensible input and retrieval), **say it** (pronunciation, tone, conversation), or **live it** (community, culture, people).

There are 9 principles. A later screen card cites a principle by its id. A citation of `LP-01` resolves to the heading `LP-01` in this file.

| id | job | name |
| --- | --- | --- |
| LP-01 | learn it | Input before the check |
| LP-02 | learn it | Retrieval is kept |
| LP-03 | learn it | A failed load tells the truth |
| LP-04 | say it | The learner says the line |
| LP-05 | say it | Tone is a shape |
| LP-06 | say it | Unsure is a state |
| LP-07 | live it | A place with people |
| LP-08 | live it | Familiar patterns carry a turn |
| LP-09 | live it | The turn stays |

## LP-01

id: LP-01
job: learn it
name: Input before the check

The learner meets comprehensible input before a retrieval check. A story, a dialogue, or a lesson line comes first. The check asks for a form the learner has already seen or heard.

## LP-02

id: LP-02
job: learn it
name: Retrieval is kept

A review, a quiz, or a game round finishes learn it when the result is stored for a later session. The stored result is the point of the round.

## LP-03

id: LP-03
job: learn it
name: A failed load tells the truth

When the input cannot load, the screen says what happened, why, and the next step. The learner can tell a failed load from today's lesson.

## LP-04

id: LP-04
job: say it
name: The learner says the line

Say it is a spoken line: pronunciation, tone, or a turn in conversation. The screen asks the learner to say the line. The spoken line is the job.

## LP-05

id: LP-05
job: say it
name: Tone is a shape

A target-language word on a speaking surface can show one pitch contour, the same shape in a lesson, a chat, a game, a persona, and the dictionary. The contour is a shape. Colour may sit on that shape. The shape remains if the colour is removed.

## LP-06

id: LP-06
job: say it
name: Unsure is a state

When the check is unsure, the microphone is declined, or the tutor is unavailable, the screen names that state and offers another try or a skip. The learner sees the real state of the check.

## LP-07

id: LP-07
job: live it
name: A place with people

Live it is the language used with a person, or inside a cultural moment with people: a circle, a class, a market line, a correction, or a story from an elder.

## LP-08

id: LP-08
job: live it
name: Familiar patterns carry a turn

Chat, status, and clips may keep a familiar shape. Each one carries a target-language turn: a status in the language, a saved phrase, a reply, or a correction.

## LP-09

id: LP-09
job: live it
name: The turn stays

A message, a call, or a contribution keeps the learner's words. A star, a correction, or a save attaches the phrase to the learner so the turn can be used again.
